title: Provisioning Runbook
text: Create the tenant record in the admin console with a unique lowercase tenant ID. The tenant ID is permanent and cannot be renamed.

title: Provisioning Runbook
text: Assign exactly one subscription tier (Starter, Business, or Enterprise) before activation. Tier changes after activation go through the change request process.

title: Provisioning Runbook
text: Activate the tenant and run the verification checklist. Provisioning typically completes within 2 business days of a complete request.

title: Subscription Tiers
text: Starter includes up to 10 users and email support. Business includes up to 100 users, priority support, and single sign-on. Enterprise includes unlimited users, a dedicated support channel, and a custom contract. Uptime commitments are listed in the Service Level Agreement, not in this overview.

title: Maintenance Windows
text: Standard maintenance runs on Sundays from 02:00 to 04:00 UTC. Standard maintenance is scheduled in advance and is not an uptime guarantee.

title: Service Level Agreement
text: Business tier: 99.9% monthly uptime. Starter tier: no uptime commitment. Enterprise tier: as stated in the customer's signed contract.

title: Service Level Agreement (proposed v2)
text: Proposed: Enterprise tier 99.95% monthly uptime. Not approved. Do not quote.

title: Acme Contract Addendum
text: Enterprise tier: 99.95% monthly uptime. If uptime falls below 99.95% in a month, a service credit of 10% of the monthly fee applies.

title: Acme Tenant Record
text: Acme is provisioned in the eu-west region under the Enterprise tier. Production namespace: acme-prod-eu.

title: Globex Contract Addendum
text: Business tier: 99.5% monthly uptime commitment. A service credit of 5% of the monthly fee applies below that level.

title: Globex Tenant Record
text: Globex is provisioned in the us-east region under the Business tier. Production namespace: globex-prod-us.
